tagline.en_US: A web reverse proxy and gateway with a browser-based management interface, certificate management and plugins. Its Docker socket integration is disabled in this profile because the app runs directly in its own LXC.

description.en_US: Zoraxy is a general-purpose HTTP reverse proxy and forwarding tool with a built-in management interface. It enables routing and load balancing of web traffic with support for HTTP/2, WebSockets, and redirection rules. The system includes automated TLS certificate management via ACME, IP and country-based access controls, stream proxying, and built-in network monitoring utilities.
